title: Preflight request trace event state
description: Shape of the `state` field for preflight-requests trace events.

pageOrigin.description: Origin of the page whose JavaScript makes the call (scheme + host + port).

apiOrigin.description: Origin of the API being called.

clock.description: Seconds since the page loaded; only advanceSeconds moves it, and cached preflights expire against it.

api.description: How the API answers an OPTIONS preflight.

corsEnabled.description: Whether the API has a CORS handler at all.

authFilterFirst.description: Whether a security filter authenticates OPTIONS before the CORS handler runs.

allowOrigin.description: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: an origin, '*', or null when the header is not sent.

maxAge.description: Access-Control-Max-Age in seconds as configured; 0 when the header is not sent.

call.description: The fetch() being made (absent before the first one).

headers.description: Request headers as the fetch call set them.

safelisted.description: Whether this header is on the CORS request safelist, i.e. does not trigger a preflight.

credentials.description: Whether the call was made with credentials: 'include' (cookies on the real request).

needsPreflight.description: Whether this call has to be preflighted.

trigger.description: What forced the preflight: the method, a non-safelisted header, or the Content-Type value.

triggerDetail.description: The offending method or header name; empty when no preflight is needed.

preflight.description: The OPTIONS handshake for the current call.

status.description: How far the handshake got: not needed, served from the cache, sent, granted or refused.

requestMethod.description: Access-Control-Request-Method: the method the browser asks about.

requestHeaders.description: Access-Control-Request-Headers: non-safelisted header NAMES, lowercased and sorted.

responseStatus.description: Status of the OPTIONS answer; 0 when no preflight was sent.

effectiveMaxAge.description: Seconds the browser actually remembers the answer for, after its own cap.

reason.description: Technical code for why the preflight was refused; null when nothing was refused.

detail.description: The offending status, origin, method or header name behind `reason`; empty when not applicable.

outcome.description: What happened to the current call.

stage.description: How far the call has progressed.

realRequestSent.description: Whether the real request left the browser at all.

cache.description: Preflight answers the browser is still allowed to reuse.

headers.description: The header names this entry was granted for.

credentials.description: The credentials mode this entry was granted for — a different mode is a different entry.

expiresAt.description: Clock value at which this entry stops being usable.

stats.description: Running totals across the whole run.

cacheHits.description: Preflights skipped because a remembered answer was still valid.

denied.description: Calls whose preflight was refused, so the real request never left.

realRequests.description: Real requests that reached the API.

roundTrips.description: Total network round trips: preflights plus real requests.
